title: Verify webhook events
description: Verify signatures, preserve event ids, and acknowledge webhooks quickly.
text: Verify webhook events Treat webhook requests as untrusted input. Verify the signature before parsing the event, persist the event id for idempotency, and return a fast 2xx response after the event is durably queued. A safe handler shape If processing fails, retry from the queue rather than asking the provider to resend a request you have already accepted. Keep the original event id in logs and traces.
